objectives.title: Verify and assemble 166 parts
objectives.requirement: Check footprint, exact part, orientation, hold-up capacitance and authorized solder contacts

objectives.title: Construct 232 routes and 76 vias
objectives.requirement: Certified 18-layer topology, isolation DRC, no power shorts and valid redundancy paths

objectives.title: Commission redundant power and controls
objectives.requirement: Demonstrate independent 12V sources, OR-ing isolation, 5V/3.3V power and clock vote

objectives.title: Prove failover and data integrity
objectives.requirement: Measure controlled load transfer, hold-up droop, ECC errors, watchdog and diagnostic timestamps

objectives.title: Recover three true hardware faults
objectives.requirement: Repair power-path MOSFET, ECC memory via and independent clock supervisor then fresh qualification

objectives.title: Complete W233 supervised authorization recovery
objectives.requirement: Disconnect monitoring feedback, show independent latch, reconnect and retest full failover
